content_sections.heading: BEL Probationary Engineer Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: There are 350 vacancies across two engineering disciplines. The post-wise distribution is given below.

content_sections.heading: BEL Probationary Engineer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for BEL Probationary Engineer posts must meet the educational qualification and age requirements specified in the official notification. Electronics: B.E / B.Tech / B.Sc (4 Years) Engineering in Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Electronics and Telecommunication, Communication or Telecommunication. Mechanical: B.E / B.Tech / B.Sc (4 Years) Engineering in Mechanical. General, OBC (NCL) and EWS candidates must have First Class in the qualifying degree. SC, ST and PwBD candidates are eligible with Pass Class. Eligible candidates with AMIE / AMIETE / GIETE qualifications in the specified disciplines may also apply. Other equivalent disciplines and dual specialisations will not be considered. Candidates should carefully verify their qualification against the official notification. The maximum age limit for General and EWS candidates is 25 years as on 1 October 2026. Age relaxation is applicable according to government guidelines.

content_sections.heading: BEL Probationary Engineer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be appointed in E-II Grade with a basic pay scale of Rs. 40,000 - 3% - Rs. 1,40,000. The approximate annual CTC is Rs. 13 lakh. Employees will also be eligible for allowances and benefits, including Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Conveyance Allowance, Performance Related Pay and Medical Reimbursement, as admissible under company rules.

content_sections.heading: BEL Probationary Engineer Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid online through the prescribed payment gateway. The fee is non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: BEL Probationary Engineer Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: The BEL Probationary Engineer online application window opened on 28 October 2026 and will close on 18 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. Interested and eligible candidates should submit their applications through the official recruitment website before the deadline. Apply Online: BEL Official Recruitment Website

content_sections.heading: BEL Probationary Engineer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a Computer-Based Test (CBT) followed by an interview. Candidates shortlisted through the CBT will be called for an interview in a 1:5 ratio, discipline-wise and category-wise. Computer-Based Test: 85% weightage. Interview: 15% weightage. Minimum Qualifying Marks: 35% for General/OBC/EWS and 30% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates in each stage separately.

content_sections.heading: BEL Probationary Engineer Syllabus and Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The BEL Probationary Engineer Computer-Based Test will contain 125 objective-type questions, including 100 technical questions from the relevant engineering discipline and 25 General Aptitude and Reasoning questions. Candidates will have 120 minutes to complete the examination. Candidates preparing for the examination can check the detailed subject-wise topics, Electronics and Mechanical Engineering syllabus, marking scheme and preparation-related information in the separate syllabus article. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BEL has announced 350 vacancies, including 200 Electronics and 150 Mechanical Probationary Engineer posts.

faq.question: Q2. When does the BEL Probationary Engineer online application start?
faq.answer: Online registration for the BEL Probationary Engineer posts opens on 28 October 2026 at 02:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application with the fee is 18 November 2026, up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for BEL Probationary Engineer 2026?
faq.answer: GEN/EWS/OBC (NCL) candidates pay Rs 1000/- + GST, i.e. Rs. 1180/-, online through SBI e-Pay Lite. SC/ST/PwBD/ESM candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BEL Probationary Engineer?
faq.answer: The maximum age for Unreserved/EWS candidates is 25 years as on 1 October 2026. OBC (NCL) candidates get 3 years of relaxation, SC/ST and Ex-Servicemen 5 years, PwBD 10 years, PwBD & OBC (NCL) 13 years and PwBD & SC/ST 15 years.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for BEL Probationary Engineer?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E / B.Tech / B.Sc (4 Years) Engineering degree in the listed Electronics disciplines or in Mechanical. UR/OBC (NCL)/EWS candidates need a First class from AICTE approved Colleges, and SC/ST/PwBD candidates need a Pass class. A first class in AMIE / AMIETE / GIETE in these disciplines is also accepted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of BEL Probationary Engineer?
faq.answer: The basic pay scale is Rs. 40,000-3%-1,40,000, with a CTC of 13 lacs (Approx.). DA, HRA, Conveyance Allowance, Performance Related Pay, Medical Reimbursement and other perquisites are paid as admissible.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a computer based test (85 marks) and an interview (15 marks). CBT performance decides shortlisting for interview in the ratio of 1:5, discipline-wise and category-wise.

faq.question: Q9. Is there negative marking in the BEL Probationary Engineer CBT?
faq.answer: Yes. 1/4th of a mark is deducted for each wrong answer in the 125-question, 120-minute CBT, and no marks are given for unattempted questions. The CBT is tentatively scheduled for 22 December 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a service bond for BEL Probationary Engineer?
faq.answer: Yes. After 6 months of Orientation / On-the-Job training, selected candidates must sign a Service Agreement to serve BEL for 2 years. The amount payable for breaking it is Rs. 2,00,000/-.
